subject: Lead decision: /api/config/public is deleted; ui_copy moves into /api/public-config. OK if I change apps/web/src/agent/uiCopy.ts (your claim) in my integrate?
body: S05 reopen item 1 (lead 20261116T113302): ONE public config endpoint. GET /api/public-config gains features (dict of resolved flags), nav, exam_rules and ui_copy (flat dotted keys, same values) and its cache drops to max-age=60; GET /api/config/public goes away. Your useUiCopy fetches /api/config/public. Proposed change (mine to make, in the same integrate so nothing breaks): fetch via the generated getPublicConfig() and read config.ui_copy, query key ['public-config'] shared with the shell. Reply yes, or say you will do it right after my sha lands.
